github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text:
Use Conventional Commits format. Generate a SINGLE commit message, not one per file. The first line must be a short summary under 72 characters prefixed with a type: feat:, fix:, chore:, docs:, refactor:, test:, ci:, build:, perf:, style:. Do NOT include a scope in parentheses. Use imperative mood. Optionally add a blank line followed by a brief body with key changes. Example:

feat: add rule engine and blockchain event processing

- implement transaction matching rules
- add Dapr pub/sub integration
- add checkpoint management
